protocol.inner_calibration: held identity unknown and remaining identities known, 0.4 < frac <= 0.6
protocol.evaluation: outer held identity and known identities, frac > 0.8
protocol.identity_decision: top-1 strict LDA-cos prototype score; calibration never changes ranking
protocol.C0: raw top-1 max-cos score, E247 strict LDA-cos shrink 0.01
protocol.C1_margin: L2 logistic calibration of top-1 and top-1 minus top-2 margin
protocol.C2_margin_cohort_hubness: L2 logistic calibration of top-1, margin, cohort mean/std and predicted-prototype hubness
protocol.standardization: median/MAD fitted only on pooled inner calibration features
protocol.logistic: PyTorch L2 logistic, labels known=1 and pseudo-unknown=0
protocol.threshold: weighted identity-balanced FAR10 threshold from pseudo-unknown scores
protocol.session: not used; only the metadata session validation in E247 is retained
protocol.test_data: not read; no Test result participates in fitting or selection
protocol.attack_logic: not_used; E249 gates_attack.py is not imported
